content.text: Based on my thorough audit of the InkOS Next.js 16 app, here are the top performance issues I found: ## Top 20 Performance Issues 1. **40 'use client' marked components** — excessive client-side hydration (effort: M) Many server-capable components marked as client. Audit components like `/components/commissions/*`, `/components/waitlist/*`, `/components/clients/*` to move data fetching to server components. 2. **InboxClient.tsx — large 'use client' page component** — entire heavy Inbox system marked client when only UI interactions need it (app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx → InboxClient.tsx, effort: L) Server should fetch/transform data; client only handles filtering/sorting. 3. **Inbox page 487 lines** — monolithic layout with 12 parallel Promise.all queries (app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx:40-135, effort: M) Add Suspense boundaries to stream sections independently instead of blocking on all queries. 4. **Missing pagination on inbox queries** — `.limit(50)`, `.limit(30)`, `.limit(20)` on bookmark/consent/waitlist without cursor-based offsets (app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx:63, 74, 84, effort: M) N+1 risk on table views; implement cursor pagination for large tables. 5. **AppLayout layout.tsx runs 8 sequential queries after 2 dependencies** — heavy layout blocking all child pages (app/(app)/layout.tsx:40-135, effort: M) Add Suspense boundaries around dynamic badge counts; pre-compute MTD commissions server-side if static enough. 6. **205 useEffect hooks across components** — heavy effect chains with likely missing deps and re-render storms (effort: L) Audit top 20 files by useEffect density; convert many to event handlers or server-side logic. 7. **293 React.memo/useMemo/useCallback usages insufficient** — only 293 memoization calls for 172+ components with .map() (effort: M) Many table rows (TopEarnersLeaderboard, CommissionRecords) re-render entire list on prop changes. 8. **TopEarnersLeaderboard.tsx:39-47** — Array.from({ length: 5 }).map() with array index as key `key={i}` on skeletons (effort: S) Use unique ID if available, replace with semantic loading placeholders. 9. **CommissionsDashboard.tsx:105-108** — KPI card re-renders on every parent state change; needs React.memo + useMemo on formatCurrency (effort: S) 10. **5 img tags found** — only 2 next/image imports (effort: M) Replace remaining with next/image; add width+height to prevent CLS. 11. **CommissionsHub, LeaderboardTab, RecordsTable all marked 'use client'** — fetch data via useQuery instead of server components (components/commissions/, effort: L) Move API fetches to server route or RSC child components. 12. **Large page bundle: artists/schedules (661 lines), book/flash (685 lines)** — no dynamic() import splitting (effort: L) Lazy-load FullCalendar, Tiptap editor, chart components with React.lazy or next/dynamic. 13. **Book public pages** — fetch studio/service/artist data without revalidate/cache directives (app/book/[studioSlug]/page.tsx:349 lines, effort: M) Add `export const revalidate = 3600` (1h) for public pages; enable ISR. 14. **No Suspense boundaries in inbox, calendar, commissions pages** — one slow Supabase query blocks entire page load (effort: L) Wrap slow count/metric queries in Suspense with fallback skeletons. 15. **WaitlistTable.tsx** — inline style objects on every map iteration (style={{ backgroundColor: entry.service.color }}, effort: S) Move to CSS custom properties or memoized color computation. 16. **LeaderboardTab.tsx:73** — recalculates Sparkline SVG path on every render (effort: S) Wrap Sparkline in useMemo with data dependency. 17. **ClientDialog.tsx, MessageComposer.tsx** — create error objects `{}` on every state update (effort: S) Use null checks or memoized empty object constants. 18. **Supabase queries missing .limit() before .select()** — risk of unbounded result sets (app/sitemap.ts, effort: M) Add .limit(1000) or pagination keys on all list queries. 19. **Next.config.ts optimizePackageImports configured** (lines 18-23) but limited to 4 packages; missing for @tanstack/react-table, @tiptap, lucide-react client bloat (effort: M) Add more packages to tree-shakeable imports list. 20. **No cache() directives on server component queries** — all Supabase fetches rerun on every page request (effort: M) Wrap stable queries (studio, artist list) in `cache()` to dedupe within request. **Key wins:** Suspense boundaries (issues #3, #5, #14) are quick wins. Memo components in lists (#7, #9). Move client fetches server (#11, #12). Revalidate config (#13).
